Enjoy an Officially Licensed MLB Baseball Game Anytime, Anywhere

Experience the fully integrated 2025 MLB schedule, and take on the World Series with 2025 Live Cards!

 

The game chosen by 2-time National League MVP Bryce Harper, MLB RIVALS!

 

■ MLB RIVALS Game Features

 

[NEW]

# Moment Card: Easier development to become the core of your team!

# Lineup Synergy: Build your own dream team with a variety of cards!

# Ranked Tournaments: Find out who’s the true champion!

 

[REAL]

# 2025 MLB season schedule, stadiums, and uniforms fully featured!

# 2025 Live Cards that reflect real-time performance!

# Realistic player motions captured with cutting-edge technology!

# Relive the most thrilling moments with the Replay system!

 

[PLAY]

# [Quick, Highlight, or Full Play]: Choose how you want to enjoy the game!

# Ranked Slugger: Become the true Home Run King!

# Live Match: Face off against rivals from around the world in real time!

# Club Battle: Join forces with your Club members to challenge the top clubs!

 

[EASY]

# No more complicated controls! Enjoy simple one-touch play.

# Speed through games with Quick Play and play speed settings!

# Grow your players with ease! Improved Consecutive Upgrade feature!

 

Feel the thrill of baseball action in MLB RIVALS!
